# Cart

Changes to the shopping cart.

[All domains](README.md)

## `cart_abandoned`

A cart was left without starting checkout. Reported by the merchant backend.

**Sources:** server · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commerce.cartId` | string | yes |  |

Other fields come from the `commerce` block.

```json
{
  "commerce": {
    "cartId": "c1"
  }
}
```

## `cart_quantity_updated`

**Sources:** browser · **Version:** 1

| Field | Type | Required | Constraints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `commerce.productId` | string | yes |  |

  }
